description: This file defines the ConceptSet class, representing a concept within a concept set in the OpenMRS core API. It includes fields for concept identifiers, related concepts, sorting weight, creator, and creation date, along with methods for access and comparison.

classes.name: ConceptSet
classes.description: Entity class representing a concept within a concept set, with properties such as concept, parent concept, sort weight, creator, and creation date, implementing comparability and serialization.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this set.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this set.

methods.name: getConceptSet
methods.description: Returns the parent concept that uses this set.

methods.name: setConceptSet
methods.description: Sets the parent concept that uses this set.

methods.name: getSortWeight
methods.description: Returns the sorting weight for ordering concepts.

methods.name: setSortWeight
methods.description: Sets the sorting weight for ordering concepts.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created this concept set.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator of this concept set.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date this concept set was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of this concept set.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier of this concept set object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this concept set object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ConceptSet to another for ordering, based on concept's retirement status and sort weight.
